description: Clinical engagement features share the same underlying platform infrastructure as customer engagement. The clinical engagement module extends account management, visit management, consent, and compliance features with clinical-specific workflows such as clinical trial management, investigator site management, and medical affairs engagement tracking.
setup_steps: Follow the customer engagement setup guide as the foundation
Enable clinical-specific permission sets and record types
Configure clinical record types for visits (e.g., medical science liaison visits)
Set up clinical compliance programs using care programs and action plan templates
prerequisites: Customer engagement managed package installed and configured
Territory management configured for clinical territories
configuration_details: Clinical engagement uses the same core objects as customer engagement (Visit, Activity Plan, Consent, etc.)
Clinical record types differentiate clinical visits from commercial visits
Medical science liaison (MSL) workflows use the same visit management infrastructure
Clinical compliance requirements are modeled as care programs with clinical-specific action plan templates
Investigator engagement tracking uses account management with clinical-specific fields and layouts
batch_jobs: Same batch jobs as customer engagement apply to clinical workflows
gotchas: Clinical engagement does NOT have a separate documentation set - it shares the customer engagement documentation and feature infrastructure
All customer engagement setup steps apply to clinical engagement as a prerequisite
Clinical-specific functionality is achieved through record types, page layouts, and permission sets rather than separate objects
Medical affairs and commercial teams may share the same org but need separate profiles and permission sets
Clinical consent requirements may be more stringent than commercial - configure consent data use purposes accordingly
mobile_considerations: Clinical field users (MSLs) use the same mobile app as commercial reps. Metadata cache configurations should include clinical record types and clinical-specific fields.
admin_console_settings: Same admin console as customer engagement

description: Specialized visit workflows for medical science liaisons conducting scientific exchange with healthcare providers, key opinion leaders, and investigators. Uses the same visit management infrastructure with clinical-specific record types and engagement pages.
setup_steps: Configure visit management per customer engagement guide
Create clinical visit record types (MSL Visit, Scientific Exchange, etc.)
Configure visit engagement page layouts for clinical record types
Set up clinical-specific GoTo actions and quick actions
Set up clinical visit objectives and discussion topics
configuration_details: MSL visits track scientific exchange topics rather than product detailing
Clinical visit objectives focus on medical education and research collaboration
Compliance statements for MSL visits address off-label discussion guardrails
Clinical visit record types route to specialized engagement pages
gotchas: MSL and commercial visit types must be clearly separated to maintain compliance boundaries
Clinical compliance statements have different regulatory requirements than commercial
Ensure medical affairs users cannot access commercial visit types and vice versa
mobile_considerations: MSLs use the same mobile app with clinical-specific visit engagement pages. Ensure metadata cache includes clinical record types.
admin_console_settings: Visit record type routing for clinical types

description: Regulatory compliance tracking for clinical engagement activities using care programs and action plan templates configured for clinical requirements such as investigator engagement, transparency reporting, and medical information exchange.
setup_steps: Follow provider engagement compliance setup from customer engagement
Create clinical-specific care programs (e.g., Investigator Engagement, Transparency Reporting)
Create clinical action plan templates with clinical milestones
Configure clinical compliance cycles aligned to regulatory periods
Set up clinical-specific sharing rules for compliance data
prerequisites: Care programs and action plan framework configured
configuration_details: Clinical compliance programs may have different cycle periods than commercial (e.g., annual reporting vs quarterly)
Transparency reporting programs track healthcare provider payments and transfers of value
Investigator engagement programs track site interactions and study-related activities
Clinical compliance data may require restricted sharing due to regulatory sensitivity
gotchas: Clinical compliance requirements vary by country and regulation (e.g., Sunshine Act, EFPIA Code)
Compliance data for clinical teams may need to be segregated from commercial compliance data
Transparency reporting deadlines are typically annual with specific cutoff dates
mobile_considerations: Clinical compliance information is accessible on mobile during investigator visits
